title: The app thats changing my life
body: I was skeptical about habit apps, but really wanted to cultivate a way of being more consistent with my beliefs and needs so I researched a few. Habitify came up as an option with good reviews, and with an option for a once-off payment granting lifetime access which I figured was the best value for money. The app itself is easy to use, allowing you to add many habits over time as earlier ones become routinized, with the option of reminders at particular times of day for each one. Whats more, you can track your progress weekly or monthly and even check out around what times you are usually able to tick off certain habits. I believe the app is helping me change my life and I strong recommend it for the reasons mentioned above, and many others too numerous to type out here.
